Assessment standard

Demonstrate mastery

Progress is earned through correct reasoning, transfer to unfamiliar problems, credible empirical analysis, and clear explanation. Studying time and page counts are inputs; they do not establish competence.

Every chapter

Complete at least eight original exercises (ten in graduate technical chapters), reconstruct the worked examples, explain a mechanism without notes, and answer a later retention question. Determinate problems have complete solutions. Open questions have evaluation criteria and may admit several defensible answers.

Every volume

Complete a prerequisite diagnostic, cumulative examination, distinct reassessment form, integrative project, oral explanation, and delayed retention check. Projects specify inputs, outputs, assumptions, uncertainty, reproducibility and scoring. Volume-specific examination and project materials will appear when their packages are written.

Advancement criteria

Our proposed default for numerical/conceptual exams is at least 85% overall with no essential domain below 75%, plus a transfer problem and teach-back. These are design choices for this library, not university requirements. Critical errors in identification, units, budget balance, risk interpretation or integrity require correction regardless of the total.

Graduate and research assessment

Graduate work adds proofs, derivations, model critique, empirical identification and numerical diagnostics. The research portfolio includes replication, referee reports, a proposal, original work and an oral defense. Qualified researchers must evaluate its contribution and correctness; the book cannot award that judgment automatically.

Teaching and leadership

A teaching portfolio contains undergraduate and graduate syllabi, lessons, assessments, grading criteria, observed teaching and research-supervision plans. A leadership portfolio contains strategy, budgets, decision rights, hiring and incentives, risk and crisis decisions, and a retrospective on real responsibility. Independent observation and real experience are essential.

Editorial acceptance

A chapter package is accepted only after its instruction, worked examples, exercises, solutions, sources and review record satisfy the production contract. Source-link checks, numerical checks and subject-matter review are recorded separately. Draft is a transparent production state, not a mastery credential.
